module: Data manager of the Assembly Spline tool: holds the list of assembly splines (assemblySplines) and the id -> index table (splineMap), creates/deletes/splits/joins splines, applies kit presets (Wooden Fence, Telegraph Pole, Metal Crash Barrier), handles profile copy/paste, serialization, undo/redo callbacks, links with the Master Spline tool and the update of "dirty" splines (geometry recomputation then repopulation with meshes via populate). Each spline is a table (name, id, nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, spacing, verticalOffset, normalMode, sag, preRot, jitter*, splineRandomSeed, kitFolderPath, meshKit, moleculeDescription, isEnabled, isDirty, isLink, linkId, sceneTreeFolderId...) and each spline has a SimGroup in MissionGroup (cansave = false until baked).
notes: Presets (setPreset key): 'wooden_fence', 'telegraph_pole', 'metal_crash_barrier'; each defines a kit folder under assets/meshes/props/assembly_kit/, spacing, normalMode (1 = global up, 2 = terrain up), preRot (0, 1 = 90 deg, 2 = 180 deg around Z).
Splines use a minimum of 100 subdivisions (minSplineDivisions); bitmap path import ignores outlines whose smallest AABB dimension is <= 10 m.
A spline with fewer than 2 nodes has no mesh: updateDirtyAssemblySplines deletes its meshes and clears its secondary geometry.
updateDirtyAssemblySplines calls session.markEdited('assemblySpline') when at least one spline was rebuilt.

In convertPathsToAssemblySplines, the log message prints #paths - #assemblySplines as the number of skipped paths: the computation is wrong if splines already existed before the call, and splines created for paths that are too small remain in the list, empty (inferred from code).
M.deepCopyAssemblySplineState is assigned twice in the public interface (harmless).

getToolPrefixStr.desc: Returns the global prefix of the tool ('Assembly Spline').

getAssemblySplines.desc: Returns the live table of assembly splines (not copied).

getSplineMap.desc: Returns the id -> index table of the splines.

setAssemblySpline.desc: Places a spline at the given index, creates a SimGroup for it in MissionGroup if needed (unique name + UUID, cansave = false) and marks it dirty.

setAssemblySplines.desc: Applies setAssemblySpline to each element of the list.

getDefaultSliderParams.desc: Returns the default slider parameters (those of the Wooden Fence preset): spacing, verticalOffset, normalMode, sag, preRot, jitterForward/Right/Up, splineRandomSeed.

setPreset.desc: Applies a preset to the spline: deletes its meshes, reloads the kit (mol.getAssemblyKit), rebuilds the molecule and copies the preset parameters, then marks the spline dirty. Unknown key: only marked dirty.

addNewAssemblySpline.desc: Adds an empty spline (unique name "Assembly Spline N", UUID, SimGroup) with the default Wooden Fence kit. If the kit fails to load, a warning is logged and the kit is empty. Updates splineMap.

removeAssemblySpline.desc: Deletes the spline at the given index: its meshes (pop.tryRemove), its SimGroup, then removes it from the list and updates splineMap.

findAssemblySpline.desc: Finds a live spline by id.

removeLinkedAssemblySpline.desc: Deletes a linked spline by id (called when a Master Spline layer is deleted).

removeAllAssemblySplines.desc: Deletes all splines if isIncludeDisabled is true; otherwise only those that are enabled and not linked.

deepCopyAssemblySpline.desc: Deep copy of a spline (string.buffer encode/decode), clearing the derived secondary geometry (divPoints, divWidths, tangents, binormals, normals, discMap).

deepCopyAssemblySplineState.desc: Deep copy of all splines (for the undo history).

splitAssemblySpline.desc: Splits the selected spline in two at the selected node. Does nothing if the spline is invalid.

joinAssemblySplines.desc: Joins two open splines into one (spline1 modified, spline2 deleted) according to the given end nodes (geom.joinSplineGeometry). Does nothing if the splines or the join case are invalid.

singleSplineEditUndo.desc: Undo callback for an edit of a single spline.

singleSplineEditRedo.desc: Redo callback for an edit of a single spline.

transSplineEditUndo.desc: Undo callback for a cross-spline edit (full state of the splines).

transSplineEditRedo.desc: Redo callback for a cross-spline edit.

objectSelectUndo.desc: Undo callback for an object selection operation (restores data.old).

objectSelectRedo.desc: Redo callback for an object selection (applies data.new).

copyAssemblySplineProfile.desc: Copies the profile of a spline: deep copy without identity, nodes, widths, normals or derived geometry (what remains: parameters, kit, molecule, enabled states).

pasteAssemblySplineProfile.desc: Applies a copied profile to a spline: first deletes its meshes, copies parameters/kit/molecule/enabled states, then marks it dirty.

serializeAssemblySpline.desc: Serializes a spline into an encoded blob (string.buffer) for editor persistence (see onSerialize).

serializeAssemblySplineToTable.desc: Serializes a spline into a simple portable table for a session file (toolUtilities/session): derived geometry cleared, scene handle removed, live spline unmodified.

deserializeAssemblySpline.desc: Deserializes a spline from an encoded blob (string) or a session JSON table. On the JSON path, ensures the derived tables exist and rehydrates positions as vec3 before the first build.

isCreateObject.desc: Create the spline's scene SimGroup (inferred from code).

recomputeIdMap.desc: Recomputes the id -> index table (called by the session helper after a load).

updateDirtyAssemblySplines.desc: For each dirty spline: recomputes the geometry (Catmull-Rom with raycast if isConformToTerrain, otherwise free in 3D), repopulates with meshes (pop.populateAssemblySpline) and updates roadLength. Below 2 nodes, deletes the meshes. Called every frame by onEditorGui.

conformNodesToTerrain.desc: Once places the control nodes on the surface below (vertical raycast) then marks the spline dirty. To be rerun after terraforming.

convertPathsToAssemblySplines.desc: Converts paths drawn from a bitmap into assembly splines: grid coordinates -> world via the terrain editor, terrain normals for each node. Requires editor_terrainEditor.

getCurrentAssemblySplineList.desc: List of enabled splines as {name, id, type = 'Assembly Spline'} (for the Master Spline tool).

isLinked.desc: Indicates whether the spline with the given id is linked to a Master Spline.

setLink.desc: Links or unlinks a spline (isLink, linkId = groupId), deletes its meshes and marks it dirty.

updateLinkedAssemblySpline.desc: Updates the geometry of a linked spline from the master (nodes, widths, normals, loop, terrain conformity); below 2 points, clears the derived geometry and deletes the meshes; marks dirty.

unlinkAll.desc: Unlinks all splines and marks them dirty.
